title: A stolen silver locket from the Old Library
intro_text: A silver locket has gone missing from the Old Library in Willowbrook this morning. Someone here knows more than they are saying.

locations.name: Coach Yard
locations.description: Empty spaces under a canvas awning, where the only sounds are the distant hoots of a nearby owl and the occasional creak of wooden planks.

locations.name: Old Library
locations.description: A hushed sanctuary where towering shelves reach from floor to ceiling, whispering tales of yesteryears within their pages. A lone oak table stands in the center, its surface marred by countless marks of time and use.

locations.name: Copper Kettle Cafe
locations.description: A cozy nook where the aroma of freshly brewed tea mingles with the soft clink of porcelain cups, inviting patrons to linger over steaming mugs and small talk.

methods.text: I hid it under a fruit crate near the coach yard and came back for it when no one was looking.
I swapped it with a lookalike during the rush hour at the Old Library.
I knocked over a display of small jars and took it in the confusion.
I slipped it into my pocket while the owner was busy near the copper kettle cafe.

motives.text: I needed money for a fresh start in another town.
I wanted to prove I was smarter than the library keeper.
I hoped it would help me pay off a growing debt.
I did it for the thrill of it, no matter the cost.
